_note: Campaign-wide rules not owned by one system. PLACEHOLDER numbers; the rules themselves are confirmed in constitution.md.

loss._note: Confirmed rule (2026-10-01): a faction that loses its last settlement enters a grace period of grace_turns End Turns. If its armies retake a settlement in time it survives; otherwise it is destroyed and its armies disband. A faction with no army left when it loses its last settlement cannot retake anything and is destroyed at once. For the player, destruction is game over.
